_doc: Merge into global.CLIMATE.heat in content/climate/kubejs/startup_scripts/climate/tables.js (watts as heat per tick). The engine has a LIT block property, true only while it burns fuel, which the climate scan reads, so an idle engine adds nothing. fuel_watts are informational: heat scales with fuel energy. The modular engine has a LIT property that is true while burning (per segment); the huge engine and the burner use LIT too. Burner is also a basin heater through the blaze burner heat level property.
